title: Artist list
statementMd:
List every artist's name and country.

Expected columns: `name`, `country`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, country FROM artists;
```
